resources.string: I have saved my recovery key safely
Save this key outside Vaurivo and confirm below. Anyone with this key and your vault file can recover your data. Create a new backup after setup. Older backups retain their previous recovery access.

Authenticate to view or generate a key. Keys created by older versions may need regeneration before they can be viewed. Generating a key replaces the current key, but does not revoke access to older backups.

Enter the recovery key you previously saved while your vault was unlocked. Your records will be preserved. If you never set up recovery, or lost both your key and password, this vault cannot be recovered. There is no email reset or bypass.
Password reset. Unlock with your new password, then set up a new recovery key and create a new backup.
Recovery failed. Check the saved recovery key and try again. A key must have been set up for this vault beforehand.
Use at least 12 characters and confirm the same password.
